description: This file exports media understanding types and helper functions relevant for a media plugin SDK, including types related to audio, image, video description, and transcription, as well as functions for describing images and transcribing audio.

methods.name: describeImageWithModel
methods.description: Function to describe an image using a specified model.

methods.name: describeImagesWithModel
methods.description: Function to describe multiple images jointly using a model.

methods.name: transcribeOpenAiCompatibleAudio
methods.description: Function to transcribe audio compatible with OpenAI format.
